title: FAQ
subtitle: Things I get asked a lot

questions.label: What services do you offer?
questions.content: I offer full-stack web development (frontend & backend), infrastructure & networking setup, API design, cloud deployment, and technical consulting. If it involves code or servers, I can help.

questions.label: Can you build both the app and its infrastructure?
questions.content: Yes — that's actually my specialty. I combine software development with networking knowledge to deliver rock-solid, end-to-end solutions.

questions.label: How much does a project cost?
questions.content: Cost depends on scope, complexity, and timeline. Reach out with your project details and I'll give you a fair, transparent quote.

questions.label: How does payment work?
questions.content: I typically ask for a deposit before starting, with the remainder due upon delivery. Details are discussed per project.

questions.label: How long does a project usually take?
questions.content: Most projects are scoped between 1 week and 2 months depending on features and integrations needed.

questions.label: Do you offer student or startup discounts?
questions.content: I review each case individually. If you're a student or early-stage startup, just mention it — I'm happy to find something that works.

questions.label: What do you enjoy most about this work?
questions.content: The intersection of software and infrastructure — I love when a beautifully written app runs on a network I also designed. It's the full picture.

questions.label: Hobbies outside of work?
questions.content: Tinkering with home labs, exploring networking protocols, gaming, and occasionally breaking things on purpose just to learn how to fix them.
